reviews.text: Pool Sharks keep my pool clear.  They turned my pool from a swampy mess to blue water. I thought I would need to drain it but with a few days of dedication and determination, he made it swimmable again.  They are accommodating and also get right out when ever I have a problem.  Highly recommend them.

It’s been a year now and we have been thrilled with every aspect of Shark Pools, including the quality and price for our weekly pool service and maintenance. Gustavo is the best; he’s punctual, honest, kind, caring and a great communicator!. Our pool stays crystal clear and clean!

When everyone was out 2 weeks, Guz came to my rescue the next day.  He's the nicest guy and the charge was reasonable.   My sweeper had a problem so he fixed that, cleaned up my pool, and added chemicals.   It's clean and sparking now.  He came out a few days later when l asked about info on a part he said l needed. He came back out at no charge.   Great service.

Do NOT use this pool service. They don’t know anything about pool maintenance, chemical balance, etc. Gus came and did the “maintenance”. 3 minutes of picking up leaves, not even cleaning filters. No vacuuming, no brushing. Our pool is now covered in algae after 4 weeks of what he calls “pool service”.
I mean, just look at the reviews, friends and family writing good stuff about this joke of a business.

Gus has done a terrible job.
We only used him for a couple of week and we got so many algae.
When we asked him if he cleaned the pool he said yes, finally we started watching our cameras. He would spend 4 min just picking up the leaves and shocking the pool. Didn’t even bother to clean the very obvious spots of dirt at the bottom of the pool.
He also charged us up front so now he owes us money. He blocked our #’s, so we can’t call him.
Will report him to BBB.
Shark pools is the only company I allow to come clean my pool. They work around my schedule and always have my pool clean. Great prices and amazing service.
Payed him $120 and after the first time he went he never showed up again. He blocked my calls. Worse pool cleaning company ever. Dont waste your time or money with them
They always do an outstanding job, I have tried other companies but definitively will stay with shark pools, great quality great prices👍🏻
My pool is always spotless and blue, at real good price, I’m glad I found them
They come and service my pool the right way, they have a lot of knowledge and good customer service and always work with my schedule. Would recommend them to everyone.
Excellent service and at a very good price. I had a lot of other companies, but I definitely stayed with this company
Great service!! I’m real happy, would recommend them to everyone

data.summary: The review profile is highly suspicious. The 9 positive Google reviews are generic, anonymous, and lack convincing detail. In stark contrast, the 3 negative reviews are specific, align on serious issues (theft of service, ghosting), and read as highly authentic. The volume of positive reviews is very low for an established service, and the pattern suggests possible fake positive reviews to counter legitimate customer complaints. The business appears to have significant service integrity problems.
fake_signals: Positive reviews are generic and lack specific details (e.g., 'great service', 'good price')
Positive reviews show repetitive, simple language patterns
Negative reviews contain highly specific, credible allegations (camera footage, blocking numbers)

negative_evidence: Multiple reviews allege refusal to complete paid-for service or refund money
positive_evidence: One review mentions a return visit at no charge for a part inquiry

authentic_signals: Negative reviews provide specific, damning details (4-minute cleanings, camera verification, blocked numbers)
Negative reviews align on core complaint: paying for service not rendered
One positive review mentions a specific employee (Gustavo) and a one-year service period
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one primary review platform (Google) has data. No other platforms have ratings to compare.
